$description: Tier 3 · Component knobs for the data-b rows and blocks (packages/ui: field-row.tsx, toggle-row.tsx, metric.tsx, needs-you.tsx, banner.tsx, meta-list.tsx, steps.tsx, tile.tsx), merged with component.json at build and emitted as --c-*. It adds knobs and re-declares none. Every other size these parts draw sits on the 4px spacing scale (paddings 8 to 24, the 40px index column, the 4px tile edge) or is a stroke role (the 2px metric rule), so it needs no knob. Drawn widths (Field Row 648, Metric 175, Needs You 534, Banner 358) are only the size Figma drew; in use each part fills its container.

added.$description: The wash behind an added line. The role diff-added, lightened on stone in 1.1 (3% of the ink in the ground, 8% on graphite) so body text on it holds Lc 90. `bg-diff-added` and `bg-(--c-diff-added)` draw the same colour.

label-width.$description: The label column of the default and display sizes: fixed 140px, typed in on the Field Row frame (15:504, 15:508). The value starts 16px after it. Stacked puts the label above the value and does not read this.
